message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in any of the data acquisition or data handler code; data is loaded and passed through without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: There is no code that fetches data from a remote source with integrity verification (checksums, signed URLs, pinned commits); data loading appears to read local files via pandas/torchtext without any source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads checkpoints via torch.load() and copies pretrained model files via shutil.copy() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training; class weights are used for the loss function but no distribution validation is performed.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being cryptographically isolated, hashed, or signed, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the test split is simply a ratio-based split from the same data pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path before data is passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The truncated code shows no probability sanity checks, NaN guards, or threshold validation applied to model outputs before they are returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a biLSTM/CNN sentiment classifier, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is present.
